name: gba-translator-e2e
description: Playwright E2E tests for GBA Translator ROM verification

scripts.test:e2e: python3 scripts/materialize_test_roms.py fr de && ROM_PATH=$(pwd)/output/roms/GenedRom-fr.gba playwright test --project=boot --project=gameplay --project=translation --project=visual-regression --project=menu-navigation --project=dialogue-npc --project=battle-flow --project=exploration --project=real-gameplay --project=deps-upgrade --project=ho-oh-lugia-encounter && ROM_PATH=$(pwd)/output/roms/GenedRom-de.gba playwright test --project=german
scripts.test:e2e:release-version: python3 scripts/materialize_release_rom.py fr --release-number 156 --output output/roms/GenedRom-fr-v2.1.156.gba && ROM_PATH=$(pwd)/output/roms/GenedRom-fr-v2.1.156.gba EXPECTED_VERSION=FR.2.1.156 playwright test -c tests/e2e-playwright/playwright.release-version.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:hp-bar: python3 scripts/materialize_test_roms.py fr it de && ROM_PATH=$(pwd)/output/roms/GenedRom-fr.gba playwright test -c tests/e2e-playwright/playwright.hp-bar.config.ts
